transcript.en: Good evening everyone. My name's Phil Sutton,
transcript.zh: 大家晚上好。我叫菲尔·萨顿（Phil Sutton），

transcript.en: and I'm chairman of the Highways Committee.
transcript.zh: 是公路委员会（Highways Committee）的主席。

transcript.en: We've called this meeting to inform members of the public about the new regulations for traffic and parking we're proposing for Granford.
transcript.zh: 我们召集这次会议，是为了向公众告知针对格兰福德的交通和停车新规。

transcript.en: I'll start by summarising these changes before we open the meeting to questions.
transcript.zh: 在开始讨论问题之前，我先简要说明一下有哪些变更。

transcript.en: So, why do we need to make these changes to traffic systems in Granford?
transcript.zh: 还有，我们为什么需要对格兰福德的交通系统进行这些变更。

transcript.en: Well, we're very aware that traffic is becoming an increasing problem.
transcript.zh: 我们都非常清楚，交通问题日益严重。

transcript.en: It's been especially noticeable with the increase in heavy traffic while they've been building the new hospital.
transcript.zh: 尤其是由于新医院在建，交通繁忙状况越来越频繁。

transcript.en: But it's the overall rise in the volume of traffic of all kinds that's concerning us.
transcript.zh: 但我们关心的是总体交通流量的增长。

transcript.en: To date there's not been any increase in traffic accidents,
transcript.zh: 迄今为止，交通事故没有增加，

transcript.en: but that's not something we want to see happen, obviously.
transcript.zh: 当然我们也不希望看到这样的局面出现。

transcript.en: We recently carried out a survey of local residents,
transcript.zh: 我们最近对当地居民进行了一次调查，

transcript.en: and their responses were interesting.
transcript.zh: 他们的回复很有意思。

transcript.en: People were very concerned about the lack of visibility on some roads due to cars parked along the sides of the roads.
transcript.zh: 由于道路两侧都停放了汽车，人们非常担心道路的视野变窄了。

transcript.en: We'd expected complaints about the congestion near the school when parents are dropping off their children or picking them up,
transcript.zh: 我们曾预计，由于父母接送小孩，学校附近会出现交通堵塞的情况，

transcript.en: but this wasn't top of the list,
transcript.zh: 但这并不是最重要的，

transcript.en: and nor were noise and fumes from trucks and lorries,
transcript.zh: 货运车产生的噪音和烟雾也不是最重要的，

transcript.en: though they were mentioned by some people.
transcript.zh: 尽管有些人提到了这些问题。

transcript.en: We think these new traffic regulations would make a lot of difference.
transcript.zh: 我们认为交通新规能极大地改善这些问题。

transcript.en: But we still have a long way to go.
transcript.zh: 但是我们还有很长的路要走。

transcript.en: We've managed to keep our proposals within budget,
transcript.zh: 我们已经设法确保提案不超过预算，

transcript.en: just, so they can be covered by the Council.
transcript.zh: 以便获得理事会批准。

transcript.en: But, of course,
transcript.zh: 但是，当然，

transcript.en: it's no good introducing new regulations if we don't have a way of making sure that everyone obeys them.
transcript.zh: 如果没有办法确保每个人都遵守新规，那么出台它们也没有什么用处。

transcript.en: and that's an area we're still working on with the help of representatives from the police force.
transcript.zh: 在警方代表的帮助下，我们仍在努力解决这个问题。

transcript.en: OK, so this slide shows a map of the central area of Granford,
transcript.zh: 这张幻灯片是格兰福德中心区的地图，

transcript.en: with the High Street in the middle and School Road on the right.
transcript.zh: 中间是主道，右边是校道。

transcript.en: Now, we already have a set of traffic lights in the High Street at the junction with Station Road,
transcript.zh: 主道与车站路（Station Road）相交的十字路口已经装设了交通信号灯，

transcript.en: but we're planning to have another set at the other end, at the School Road junction,
transcript.zh: 但是我们计划在主道与校道相交的十字路口装设另一套交通信号灯，

transcript.en: to regulate the flow of traffic along the High Street.
transcript.zh: 以管理主道的交通流量。

transcript.en: We've decided we definitely need a pedestrian crossing.
transcript.zh: 我们认为有必要建一条人形横道。

transcript.en: We considered putting this on School Road,
transcript.zh: 我们本来考虑将人形横道建在校道上，

transcript.en: just outside the school,
transcript.zh: 就在学校外面，

transcript.en: but in the end we decided that could lead to a lot of traffic congestion.
transcript.zh: 但最后我们认为这会经常导致交通堵塞。

transcript.en: so we decided to locate it on the High Street,
transcript.zh: 因此我们决定把人行横道建在主道上，

transcript.en: crossing the road in front of the supermarket.
transcript.zh: 穿过超市前的道路。

transcript.en: That's a very busy area,
transcript.zh: 那是一个非常繁忙的地区，

transcript.en: so it should help things there.
transcript.zh: 所以建这条路应该会非常有帮助。

transcript.en: We're proposing some changes to parking.
transcript.zh: 我们建议对停车场进行一些改造。

transcript.en: At present, parking isn't allowed on the High Street outside the library,
transcript.zh: 目前，图书馆外的主道禁止停车，

transcript.en: but we're going to change that,and allow parking there,
transcript.zh: 但是我们会争取可以在这里停车，

transcript.en: but not at the other end of the High Street near School Road.
transcript.zh: 但不得在主道另一头的校道旁停车。

transcript.en: There'll be a new ‘ No Parking ’ sign on School Road,
transcript.zh: 在校道上有一处新的“禁止停车”标志，

transcript.en: just by the entrance to the school,
transcript.zh: 就在学校的入口处，

transcript.en: forbidding parking for 25 metres.
transcript.zh: 有25米的禁止停车区域。

transcript.en: This should improve visibility for drivers and pedestrians,
transcript.zh: 这应该可以增加司机和行人的视野，

transcript.en: especially on the bend just to the north of the school.
transcript.zh: 尤其是学校北侧的拐弯处。

transcript.en: As far as disabled drivers are concerned,
transcript.zh: 至于残疾人司机，

transcript.en: at present they have parking outside the supermarket,
transcript.zh: 目前在超市外有泊车位，

transcript.en: but lorries also use those spaces,
transcript.zh: 但货运车经常占用这些车位，

transcript.en: so we've got two new disabled parking spaces on the side road up towards the bank.
transcript.zh: 所以我们在通往银行的旁侧路上设了两个新的残疾人停车位。

transcript.en: It's not ideal,
transcript.zh: 这几个车位不是很理想，但可能比目前的情况要好。

transcript.en: but probably better than the present arrangement.
transcript.zh: 但可能比目前的情况要好。

transcript.en: We also plan to widen the pavement on School Road.
transcript.zh: 我们还计划拓宽校道上的人行道。

transcript.en: We think we can manage to get an extra half-metre on the bend just before you get to the school,
transcript.zh: 我们认为可以将学校前面那个拐弯拓宽半米。

transcript.en: on the same side of the road.
transcript.zh: 就在马路的同一侧

transcript.en: Finally, we've introduced new restrictions on loading and unloading for the supermarket,
transcript.zh: 最后，我们对超市的装卸工作实行了新的限制，

transcript.en: so lorries will only be allowed to stop there before 8 am.
transcript.zh: 货车只能在早上8点之前停靠。

transcript.en: That's the supermarket on School Road -
transcript.zh: 就是校道上的超市 -

transcript.en: we kept to the existing arrangements with the High Street supermarket.
transcript.zh: 我们遵守了与主道超市的现有安排。

transcript.en: OK. So that's about it. Now, would anyone …
transcript.zh: 好的。这个问题就说这么多。有没有人……
